caveats: unexpected_errors is 1 at 50 writers (5 repetitions x 1,000 ops) and 0 at 1/10/100 writers. Do not report this run as error-free overall; the 3-repetition run records 3 unexpected errors at 100 writers.
The CSV stores no throughput standard deviation, only p99_latency_s_std. Any +/- on a throughput figure is unsupported by these files.
'contribute' is a no-op in this harness (no observation endpoint in the distributed prototype) and still counts in the throughput denominator: 2 of every 20 timed operations perform no work.
The script docstring claims the 'same 6-op mix as the other benchmarks'; _MIX_REALISTIC contradicts it. The code is authoritative.

Not comparable to experiments/35_v28_concurrency: that harness measures in-process SQLAlchemy service calls under a uniform 6-operation mix, this one measures HTTP to containers under a read-heavy mix.
Single-host operating point on one 16-core machine with no WAN latency; not a distributed-scalability limit.
Promotion only: the sha256 values below were computed at promotion time over the existing artefacts, not over a fresh run.

config.operation_mix: _MIX_REALISTIC, 20 entries: query x8, commit x7, contribute x2, attest x1, dispute x1, restore x1
config.storage: direct sqlite3 access inside each container; no audit-history table
config.topology: 1 evidence container + 10 site containers (DIB_DIST_N_SITES=10), Docker Compose
config.worker_routing: worker_id % 10 pins each worker to one site container
